journey.name: spending confirm amount change
journey.description:
Verifies that a transfer to spending never pays more than the total Spending Confirm shows (synonymdev/bitkit-android#1361). The transfer is priced again at swipe. A price that costs the same or less pays on that swipe, at the new amount. A price whose total is higher, or that leaves less for the spending balance, pays nothing: the screen shows the new amounts and a "Fees changed" toast, and the next swipe pays them. The higher-total case needs a spend of the wallet's own UTXO outside the app, or a fee rate rise, which the Capabilities table does not list, so the unit test `swipe asks again when the network fee rose since shown` in SparkFundingViewModelTest.kt covers it.
A larger UTXO confirms while Spending Confirm is open, so the transfer is priced at swipe against a changed wallet. Coin selection may keep two inputs (150 000 + 150 000, or 150 000 + 500 000) at the same fee, or spend the new UTXO alone at a lower fee; either way the fresh price costs no more than the one shown, so the swipe pays at once.
The wallet's UTXOs and Spark's deposit must be on one chain the run can fund and mine, so it runs on bitkit-docker's local Spark regtest (docs/spark-regtest.md in synonymdev/bitkit-docker), where Savings, the Spark operators and the SSP share bitkit-docker's chain. Lightspark's hosted regtest can't be mined on demand.
Precondition: `./spark up` running in bitkit-docker; a dev build connected to it as that doc's "Point a Bitkit dev build at it" section says (the local Spark config and chain URL, patched in where the build doesn't read them yet, and the `adb reverse` ports), with Savings on bitkit-docker's Electrum (`tcp://127.0.0.1:60001`); a freshly onboarded wallet with no channel and exactly two confirmed on-chain UTXOs of 150 000 sats each (in bitkit-docker, `./spark send <savings address> 150000` twice, each mining a block). Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap Receive (testTag "Receive"), tap the "Savings" receive tab (the tab row carries no test tag), tap "Show Details" (testTag "ShowDetails"), read the address from testTag "ReceiveOnchainAddress", then press back to the home screen
Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), then "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending")
If the spending intro appears, tap "Get Started" (testTag "SpendingIntro-button")
Enter 200 000 on the number pad (testTags "N2", "N0", "N0", "N0", "N0", "N0") and tap "Continue" (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue")
Verify the confirm screen is visible (testTag "SpendingConfirmMore") and wait until its network fee is shown
Note the amounts under "Network Fees" (testTag "SpendingConfirmNetworkFee") and "Total" (testTag "SpendingConfirmTotal")
In bitkit-docker, run ./spark send <savings addr> 500000, which pays the address and mines a block
Wait 30s for the wallet to sync the new UTXO
If the received sheet (testTag "ReceivedTransaction") is visible, tap its button (testTag "ReceivedTransactionButton")
Verify the confirm screen still shows the amounts noted before the deposit
Swipe the "Swipe To Transfer" handle (testTag "GRAB") fully to the right
Verify no "Fees changed" toast appears and the setting up screen (testTag "LightningSettingUp") opens within 90s
Tap "Continue Using Bitkit" (testTag "TransferSuccess-button"), open the newest transfer in the activity list and verify its fee is no higher than the "Network Fees" amount noted
